summary: Iter 94 — Frontend-only verification of the CRMEvent internal header reorganisation (Italian). All 7 requested checks pass end-to-end on https://manage-events-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Summary of findings: (1) TRIAL org login test_header1@crmeventqa.it/TestSaas2026! (TEST_Header Org, saas.trial_end in future, trial_active=true): header shows data-testid='header-demo-button' with Video icon, Tiffany bg, black text, aria-label='Prenota una demo'; label 'Prenota una demo' at >=sm, label 'Demo' at 375px; header-assistenza-button is absent. trial-days-button is visible both on desktop (1920) and mobile (375). Clicking header-demo-button opens welcome-demo-dialog with demo-calendar rendered immediately. (2) Expired trial (set organizations.saas.trial_end='2025-01-01' via mongosh): header switches to header-assistenza-button; demo button hidden; GET /api/saas/me returns video.allowed=false, video.reason='Prova terminata – Scegli il tuo piano…'; /assistenza shows 'Prova terminata – Scegli il tuo piano…' + 'Scopri i piani' CTA; Prenota videochiamata button hidden. (3) Paid plans on same org: SILVER active → saas/me video {allowed:true, quota:3, used:0, remaining:3}; /assistenza shows 'Videochiamate utilizzate: 0 di 3 questo mese'. GOLD active → video {allowed:true, unlimited:true, priority:true}; UI shows 'Piano GOLD: videochiamate illimitate e prioritarie'. BRONZE active → video {allowed:false, support:'email', reason:'Il piano BRONZE include l’assistenza via email…'}; UI shows 'Piano BRONZE: assistenza via email' + 'Scopri i piani'. (4) Legacy QA org qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it (saas.enabled=false): header shows header-assistenza-button; header-demo-button absent; /assistenza loads full videochiamata page. (5) Dashboard search: /app has data-testid='dashboard-search' containing GlobalSearch with 'global-search-input'; header-search-button is NOT rendered on /app. On /eventi: header-search-button is visible, clicking it toggles header-search-row (sticky top), navigating back to /app hides the row (closes on route change). (6) Novità: header-news-button is icon-only (Sparkles tiffany); visible text is empty, 'Novità' present only as sr-only + title/aria-label; header-news-count badge is absent when count=0 (verified; no unread news). (7) Typography: on /app and /piattaforma body.classList contains 'app-shell'; a visible .text-sm element computed font-size is 12.6px. On public / (no auth) body does NOT have app-shell and the same .text-sm resolves to 14px. (8) Mobile 375px header overlap check (iPhone-style): all header items (mobile-menu-button, trial-days-button, header-demo-button [label 'Demo'], header-news-button, notifications-button, profile-button) fit within 375px with 0 overflow; profile-menu opens correctly and does NOT contain 'Prenota una demo'. (9) Super Admin /piattaforma: body.app-shell active, text-sm=12.6px, only clipped element is a visually-hidden sr-only span ('il link si apre in una nuova scheda', scrollWidth=50 cw=1) — not a real UI issue. Profilo & Account layout rendered without clipped text. (10) Profile menu for trial user at 375px no longer contains 'Prenota una demo gratuita' (spec requirement). welcome-demo-skip / welcome-demo-later strings use 'Lo farò in seguito' per spec (confirmed in iter 93 and still present).
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx header gating is correct: `user?.saas?.enabled && user.saas.trial_active` controls header-demo-button vs header-assistenza-button. Note: once a trial org has `purchased=true` the current condition `user.saas.trial_active` still shows the demo button only while trial_active remains true from backend — matches spec ('Purchase during trial keeps demo button until trial end' if backend keeps trial_active=true until trial_end). No code change needed; verified for the active-trial case.

NewsButton renders Sparkles icon only; 'Novità' is kept as a visually-hidden <span class='sr-only'> plus title/aria-label, which is the intended accessibility behaviour (screen reader hears 'Novità', badge appears only when count>0). The sr-only span is detected by raw innerText scraping but is NOT visible to users.

GlobalSearch is a single component imported both in Dashboard (data-testid='dashboard-search' wrapper) and in Layout's header-search-row (toggled by header-search-button on non-dashboard routes). searchOpen state is reset on location.pathname change — the 'closes on route change' spec is implemented via `useEffect(() => { setSearchOpen(false); }, [location.pathname])`.

app-typography.css provides 10% reduction (0.9x) via body.app-shell on text-xs…text-4xl incl. responsive prefixes (sm/md/lg/xl). text-xs floor is 0.72rem (~11.5px); min matches spec. Public pages do not add the class — verified at runtime.
